notes.title: Fix UI navigation issue (for Razer Tartarus??)
notes.content:
Hi, I've just updated a new patch to address the issue with UI navigation that made some players unable to play the game.

[h2]The issue:[/h2]
The game acted like the Arrow up/ W/ D-pad up button was being held down all the time.

It seemed it mostly affected players with Razer Tartarus plugged in. 

Anyway, if you had the issue before, let's download the update ([b]0.41.20[/b]), launch the game with [b]Play with mouse and keyboard[/b] option, and see if the issue is fixed for you.

Please comment your result on this post. Thank you!
